name: MTG-I2

slot_a_text: Third of EUMETSAT's third generation of weather satellite.
slot_b_text: A transfer orbit is a long ellipse. Over the coming weeks the satellite raises its own low point until the whole orbit sits 36,000 km up, where one lap takes exactly a day and it appears to hover over one spot.
description: Third of EUMETSAT's third generation of weather satellite.
rocket_fact: Specific Impulse (ISP) is the 'miles per gallon' of rocketry, measuring how efficiently an engine turns fuel into thrust.
